entries.en: student; scholar, one who studies books

entries.zh: 士人类别；读书人、士人一类
entries.en: the class of scholars/gentlemen; students as a category

entries.zh: 读书人（承上词头）；汉字“密下”与音写难以互证，具体义存疑
entries.en: student (headword as above); Chinese gloss unclear, sense doubtful
entries.notes: 汉字“密下”与音写 tak-el-tso-he 不互证，自动转写亦存两处问号，词义无法定夺。

entries.zh: 士子；读书人、士人之子（西语注 hijo del estudiante）
entries.en: scholar, gentleman of the shi class; lit. son of a scholar
"shi" (gentleman): i.e. a student, one who studies

entries.zh: 科甲人物；科举及第、有功名之人
entries.en: person of examination success, degree-holder; scholar of endowment/merit

entries.zh: 登科；科举及第、考中功名
entries.en: to pass the imperial examination, attain a degree

entries.zh: 看书、读书（首字污损难辨，“省/看”两读）
entries.en: to read books, study (first character damaged: kan/sheng readings)
entries.notes: 首字 T99 污损难辨且原稿标注“省/看”两读，据音写 cua chě（冊）暂释“看书”。

entries.zh: 攻书；刻苦读书、钻研书本
entries.en: to study hard, apply oneself to books

entries.zh: 勤读书；用功求学、勤勉向学
entries.en: to study diligently, apply oneself to study

entries.zh: 举业；为应科举而修习的学业、备考功名
entries.en: studies for the imperial (Mandarin) examinations; examination preparation

entries.zh: 永恒的、无始无终的（无起头无煞尾）
entries.en: eternal, without beginning or end; endless
entries.notes: “E Terno”疑为 Eterno 之省写/异体，据汉语“无起头无息尾”定为永恒义；起字音写带 T99 污损。
